description: Source code for MD5 cryptographic hash functions, including implementation of MD5_Init, MD5_Update, MD5_Final, and the core Transform function.

methods.name: MD5_Init
methods.description: Initializes the MD5 context with standard constants.

methods.name: MD5_Update
methods.description: Updates the MD5 context with input data, processing in 64-byte blocks.

methods.name: MD5_Final
methods.description: Finalizes the MD5 hash computation, producing the digest.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Performs the core MD5 transformation on a 64-byte block.
